info.title: API.SH: WEBTOON
info.description: The WEBTOON API from API.SH: public WEBTOON data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Comments on a WEBTOON episode: text, author, likes, dislikes, reply count, time, pinned and top comments, with the comment totals. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`, null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/webtoon-comments

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
WEBTOON's genres, or every series of one genre (title, link, authors, likes, thumbnail) sorted by popularity, likes or update date.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/webtoon-genres

parameters.name: genre
parameters.description: Genre code (from the list without genre).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
WEBTOON's rankings: trending, popular, Originals or Canvas, each with rank, series number, title, link, genre, views or likes, trend (up, down, new) and change, mature flag and thumbnail. Filter one genre with `genre`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/webtoon-ranking

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Site language: en (default), es, fr, de, id, th, zh-hant.

parameters.name: genre
parameters.description: Only this genre, e.g. romance, fantasy, action, drama, comedy, thriller.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Series matching a search, Originals and Canvas: series number, title, link, authors, views, mature flag, thumbnail and the section it was found in. `type` limits the results to Originals or Canvas and then pages with `page` (answers `type`, `page` and `next_page`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/webtoon-search

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Site language: en (default), es, fr, de, id, th, zh-hant.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: `originals` or `canvas`: only that kind of series, with paging.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (needs `type`); `next_page` is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A WEBTOON series: title, genre, authors, views, subscribers, status (ongoing or completed) and update day, age rating, summary and cover, with its episode list page by page (number, title, date, likes, thumbnail, link, locked flag). Metadata only, no episode images. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/webtoon-series

parameters.name: title_no
parameters.description: Series number, the title_no in webtoons.com/.../list?title_no=<n> (95 = Tower of God). Or give `url`.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A webtoons.com series link instead of `title_no` (Originals or Canvas).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: originals (default) or canvas, when only `title_no` is given.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Site language: en (default), es, fr, de, id, th, zh-hant.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Episode list page (newest episodes first), starting at 1.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
